· Swing Resistance ($77.30) — Resistance zone formed based on Pivot R1 ($77.90) and 5-day high ($75.30).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern — Sideways range, no clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern formed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.73) — Below 5-day average volume, reducing confidence in current price movement.
· Current Range Diagnosis — Consolidation within accumulation phase continues, maintaining wait-and-see conditions until directional confirmation.
